text:
Lena (Partnerships): Quick sync: SylvanAI wants to list Sylvan-13B on our marketplace and offer a co-sell with EdgeScale. They provided a 'Sylvan Research Use License (SRUL)'. Need to confirm redistribution for Hosted / Dedicated / Private.
Tom (Legal): SRUL appears research-first. Can you paste the redistribution line? I'll run license-checker.
Lena (Partnerships): pasted: 
```
Distribution: Model weights may be used for non-commercial research and internal evaluation. Commercial redistribution or transfer to third parties requires express written consent from SylvanAI. Hosted offerings must carry attribution.
```
Asha (Product): Implications: Dedicated customers often request downloads for on-prem; Private deployments likewise. If SRUL prohibits redistribution, our Dedicated/Private download options are blocked unless SylvanAI grants an enterprise redistribution addendum. We also need quantized artifacts.
Ravi - SylvanAI: Our preference is to keep default public listing Host-only. We can provide a commercial redistribution addendum for strategic partners or named customers; open to a partner sublicense for Redwood+EdgeScale if terms are scoped.
Hiro - EdgeScale: EdgeScale needs to pre-bundle int8 weights into appliances. We can't do per-customer signed permissions each time. A partner sublicense or a per-partner named-customer list would work. Also need NDA for certification.
Tom (Legal): Two paths: (1) Partner sublicense granting Redwood and named SI the right to distribute to paying customers (preferred for scale). (2) Per-deal distribution addenda. I'll draft both and include a certification-only NDA channel for vendors. license-checker-bot: running diff SRUL vs Apache2/MIT...
license-checker-bot: result: SRUL restricts redistribution; conflict flagged. Recommend asking SylvanAI for explicit partner carveout and provenance statement.
Lena (Partnerships): Marketing: SylvanAI wants a co-branded listing + joint blog. They want a Host-only SKU public, and an Enterprise "download+SI" SKU only available if addendum is signed. Timeline: target 6 weeks.
Asha (Product): Product needs weights for perf & quant testing. Requesting a certification bundle (NDA) in week 2, perf slot in week 4. Dedicated target: 55ms p99 on 8k for quantized Sylvan-13B.
Ravi - SylvanAI: We'll prepare provenance docs and can offer a partner sublicense limited to Redwood+EdgeScale, plus named-customer distribution list. We prefer limited indemnity and audit windows.
Tom (Legal): Good. I'll add indemnity caps, export control language, and a clause requiring provenance attestation. Also prepare a short per-customer appendix template if they prefer per-deal route.
Hiro - EdgeScale: We'll accept certification-only delivery under NDA week 2. Will upload QA spec (quant formats, test vectors) to the shared drive.
Lena (Partnerships): Actions: Tom to circulate two redlines; Sylvan to send provenance & indicate addendum preference; Asha & EdgeScale to drop QA matrices. I'll coordinate announcement embargo windows (A: partner sublicense secured = 6 weeks, B: per-deal rollout = 8-10 weeks).
Asha (Product): Noted. If we can't secure redistribution for Dedicated, we'll only offer Hosted and Private (no-download) options.
Lena (Partnerships): Thanks all 44d. Will update when Sylvan replies.
